sessionStructure.name: Dynamic Lunges
notes: Focus on perfect posture and form quality.

easierVariant.description: Reduce total exercise sets from 3 to 2 to manage local muscular fatigue.
modifications: Run only 2 sets per exercise.

harderVariant.description: Increase total sets from 3 to 4 or add minor load resistance.
modifications: Increase work volume by running 4 sets.

coachingNotes: Dynamic warm-ups prepare the muscle-tendon units and heart rate ranges.
Progress from low-velocity movements to faster dynamic drills.
Do not hold static stretches before high-intensity workouts.
commonMistakes: Rushing through the repetitions, which ruins correct movement form.
Holding your breath, which creates excessive thoracic pressure.
Neglecting proper joint alignment, placing shear load on knees or back.
safetyNotes: Listen to physical feedback; never push past sharp joint pain.
Ensure equipment is clean and weights are safely controlled.
Stop execution immediately if feeling dizzy or lightheaded.
